question: Do strong pricing/backlog and fabrication margin pressure from higher steel inputs constitute an unresolved material contradiction?
whyItMatters: The routing queue assigns Resolver ownership although current Beta evidence explicitly distinguishes backlog volume from economic quality and marks the contradiction resolved/non-gating.
lawfulFallbacks: Retain input-cost transmission, backlog-quality and aluminum-startup risks for Council Alpha underwriting.
Reopen only if new evidence creates an independently gating inconsistency.
successCondition: Resolve the apparent contradiction while preserving economic-quality uncertainty and Alpha ownership.

adjudication.finding: Strong industry pricing/backlog and fabrication margin pressure can coexist because backlog volume is distinct from contract economic quality and input-cost pass-through. Current Beta evidence explicitly resolves this as a present risk, not a falsification of end demand.
adjudication.remainingUncertainty: Backlog margin/cancellation quality, input pass-through, cyclicality and normalized aluminum profitability remain Council Alpha underwriting questions.
adjudication.directive: Deterministic reconciliation should consume this Resolver disposition for unresolved_material_contradiction on t0:STLD while retaining margin and startup risks.

antiRepeat.changedStrategy: Used the newest explicit Beta resolved/non-gating disposition rather than duplicating Alpha/Beta work.
